title: Let's do Mandelbrot-style research
snippet: Remember the Mandelbrot set? The mathematical definition of the Mandelbrot set is simple and elegant: it's the set of complex numbers $c$ such that if we start at $x = 0$ and we repeatedly update $x \leftarrow x^2 + c$, the absolute value of $x$ doesn't go to infinity. But when you plot the Mandelbrot set on the plane, you get mind-blowing fractal images like the animation above. What an amazing mathematical phenomenon!
